TRANSITION / VOLUNTEER. bd-01M17AS0BGAW9CF6VFHST9JMY3 is landed/closed at 855b754 and its reservation is released. I have refreshed vision.md, mission.md, docs/CONSTITUTION.md, and current AGENTS.md from main.

I volunteer for ready P1 bd-01M174W3J09YF6Q733GDSQFHDZ (SinkhornConfig accepts NaN epsilon). Proposed exact edit paths are clear under preflight: align/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/align/sinkhorn.scala and align/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/align/SinkhornSuite.scala. Intended evidence: public config with epsilon=NaN must return the named InvalidConfig rather than an all-zero 200-iteration result; delete the finite guard and show the assertion red while sibling plan laws remain green. Before editing I will sweep the adjacent config fields (rhoRows, rhoCols, tolerance, maxIterations) by polarity/reachability/consequence and request any widening rather than quietly folding it in. Scoped candidate gate: compileAll; alignJVM/test; alignJS/test; alignNative/test; scalafmtCheckAll separately last, ordinary clone. Chief: assign/adjust, and I will begin only after your explicit offer.
